title: Title tag present
description: A page title helps identify the page and may be used for its search-result title link.
priority_reason: A missing title leaves the page without its primary short label.
title_template: {value}; the title identifies this page in browser tabs and search results.

title: Title length
description: The 30–60 character range is an editing guide; search results may use different title text or truncate it.
priority_reason: This is editorial guidance, not a proven search ranking cutoff.
title_template: {value}; a very short or long title may omit context or display awkwardly.

title: Unique title declaration
description: Multiple title declarations can give crawlers conflicting page titles.
priority_reason: This is a markup cleanup after a usable title exists.
title_template: {value}; multiple title elements can make the page label ambiguous.

title: Meta description present
description: A meta description gives search and answer engines a summary to show.
priority_reason: This improves the page summary without asserting that search engines will always display it.
title_template: {value}; a description can help people understand the page before opening it.

title: Meta description length
description: The 70–160 character range is an editing guide; search results may choose different text or truncate it.
priority_reason: Description length is an editorial check rather than a ranking guarantee.
title_template: {value}; a very short or long summary may be less useful to readers.

title: Unique meta description declaration
description: Multiple meta descriptions can give crawlers conflicting summaries.
priority_reason: This is a markup cleanup after a useful description exists.
title_template: {value}; multiple descriptions can compete with each other.

title: Canonical URL
description: An absolute canonical link prevents duplicate-content dilution.
priority_reason: An absent canonical leaves duplicate URL preference less explicit.
title_template: {value}; a canonical link helps consolidate duplicate URL variants.

title: Unique canonical declaration
description: Multiple canonical links can give crawlers conflicting URL preferences.
priority_reason: A single coherent declaration is easier to interpret.
title_template: {value}; several canonical links can give conflicting preferred URLs.

keyword_review_policy: Optional Amendment 16 owner heuristic: 50% or more generic link/button text blocks is a review cue. Existing baseline failures survive. Prominence = count + 2 * (title 4, H1 3, description 2, headings 2, URL 1, alt 1 for present locations). There is no ideal density percentage.
title: Named links
description: Links with href need detectable source text, an aria-label, or image alt text.
priority_reason: Unclear links make navigation harder for people and assistive technology.
title_template: {value}; clear links help people decide where to go next.

title: Single H1
description: One H1 states the page topic for crawlers and assistive tech.
priority_reason: A clear primary heading improves page orientation.
title_template: {value}; the main heading helps readers identify the page subject.

title: Mobile viewport
description: A device-width viewport tag supports responsive layout; this check does not establish mobile usability or indexing.
priority_reason: Without it, mobile browsers may render a desktop-width layout.
title_template: {value}; a viewport declaration lets the layout use the device width.

title: Language declared
description: The html lang attribute tells engines and screen readers the content language.
priority_reason: Language information improves reading and pronunciation support.
title_template: {value}; the language helps browsers and assistive technology interpret text.

title: Image alt text
description: Alt attributes make images indexable and accessible.
priority_reason: Missing alternatives can exclude readers who use assistive technology.
title_template: {value}; alternative text explains informative images when they cannot be seen.

title: Open Graph tags
description: og:title, og:description and og:image control how the page is shared.
priority_reason: Preview polish is useful but does not prove search ranking or sharing uptake.
title_template: {value}; sharing metadata controls how the page may appear when linked on social platforms.

title: Indexable
description: A noindex directive removes the page from search and AI answers.
priority_reason: An unintended noindex directly conflicts with intended search discovery.
title_template: {value}; a noindex directive can keep a public page out of search results.

title: Valid JSON-LD
description: Structured data must parse to be used for rich results and AI grounding.
priority_reason: The parser must understand a declaration before its meaning can be evaluated.
title_template: {value}; invalid JSON-LD cannot be parsed as intended.

title: Question headings
description: Headings phrased as questions match how people ask answer engines.
priority_reason: Useful question headings depend on the topic, so local counts are editing cues only.
title_template: {value}; a direct question heading can make an answer easier to locate.

title: Author markup
description: Author and Person structured data carry E-E-A-T signals that answer engines weigh.
priority_reason: Attribution matters for authored content but must reflect a real person or organization.
title_template: {value}; a clear author declaration attributes article content to its source.

title: Semantic content wrapper
description: <article> or <main> lets generative engines isolate the primary content.
priority_reason: A structural correction is useful, but a wrapper alone does not establish content quality.
title_template: {value}; semantic page regions help readers and assistive technology locate the primary material.

title: Modified date
description: AI-cited pages are fresher on average; expose a machine-readable modified date.
priority_reason: Dates should be accurate; absence is not a reason to fabricate an update.
title_template: {value}; a genuine date gives readers context about when the content changed.

title: Image dimensions
description: Width and height attributes reserve space and prevent layout shift (CLS).
priority_reason: Unexpected layout movement affects reading and interaction.
title_template: {value}; image dimensions help the browser avoid layout shifts as images load.

title: Lazy-loaded images
description: This check uses image order after the first two as a lazy-loading clue; confirm which images are actually offscreen before changing loading.
priority_reason: The producer uses image order as a heuristic and does not know the viewport.
title_template: {value}; loading hints can defer images that are not needed immediately.

title: Render-blocking scripts
description: Scripts in <head> without defer/async delay first paint and raise TBT.
priority_reason: Blocking work can slow the page, but this source check does not measure load time.
title_template: {value}; scripts loaded before content can delay the first usable page.
